Name: Fancy Qi Items and Misc Stuff Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
Gives more fancy look to some endgame  items, some items have animation (similar to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6099]Animated Mining Pack[/url] mod)

[u][color=#ff7700][size=3]List of changed item textures (spoiler for endgame content):[/size][/color][/u]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=2]Secret Notes and Ginger Island Secret Notes[/size]
[*][size=2]Horse Flute[/size]
[*][size=2]Galaxy Soul - has animation![/size]
[*][size=2]Qi Gem - has animation and 5 different colors to choose from (amethyst, diamond, emerald, ruby, sapfire)[/size]
[*][size=2]Qi Seasoning  [/spoiler][/size]
[/list]

[size=2]All retextures can be enabled/disabled in config menu (Note that color changes for Qi Gem will only apply after you reload your game (due to how ContentPatcherAnimations mod patches work I guess)[/size]


[u][color=#ff7700][size=3][b]Credits:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[size=2] [/size]
[size=2]Used texture for Horse Flute from this [/size][url=http://www.deviantart.com/orteil/art/A-whole-lot-of-RPG-items-379986564]A whole lot of RPG items [/url] free pack by [url=https://www.deviantart.com/orteil]Orteil[/url]
[size=2]Used Secret Notes, Galaxy Soul and Qi Seasoning textures from [/size][url=http://henrysoftware.itch.io/godot-pixel-items]Godot Pixel Items pack[/url] by HenrySoftware
Used [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6099]Animated Mining Pack[/url]﻿ ﻿ assets as an example how to draw shining animation for Qi Gem
